description: Price history of one GPU (USD per GPU-hour) or one AI company (USD per 1M tokens), oldest first. GPU history is daily from 2025-11-07 for H100 and A100, from 2026-10-23 for the other first GPUs and from its first index day for each GPU added later, weekly before; token history is daily from 2025-01-01. Give days for the latest days, or from and to for a period (e.g. a month: from 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-31).

days.description: How many days back from the latest value.

from.description: First day of a period, YYYY-MM-DD (instead of days).

name.description: A GPU or an AI company.

to.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the latest.

name: get_price_history

errata.description: Errors found in these final values. As the page notes them under its value and the status page lists them: each a run of index days. A final value is never changed; the correct one is given when it can be recomputed, and the error is fixed from the next day

correct.description: The correct index value (none when it cannot be recomputed)

published.description: The index value as published those days (none when it differs from day to day)

reason.description: Why it was wrong, as the status page says

note.description: How the values are dated: the value in effect on the first day of a period, and where weekly values end

title: Price history
